night_start.name: {name}
night_start.text: *Back home, I hang the still-unfamiliar new uniform on a hanger and stretch out across the mattress.*

night_start_3.name: {name}
night_start_3.text: *In the quiet room, the phone by my pillow buzzes once and shows a school messenger alert.*

night_msg_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
night_msg_seo_1.text: How was the rooftop you came up to at lunch?

night_msg_seo_2.name: {name}
night_msg_seo_2.text: *The breeze was cool, and the lunch box was good too*

night_msg_seo_3.name: Seoyeon
night_msg_seo_3.text: Good. I'll have a cold drink ready tomorrow.

night_msg_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
night_msg_seo_4.text: Special service for the transfer student.

night_msg_seo_5.name: {name}
night_msg_seo_5.text: *The corner of my mouth lifts, for no real reason, at the bubble that landed on its own line below, as if she'd hesitated and then added it: “Special service for the transfer student.”*

night_msg_yuna_1.name: Yuna
night_msg_yuna_1.text: Thanks for staying quiet next to me at lunch today.

night_msg_yuna_2.name: Yuna
night_msg_yuna_2.text: I'll keep the seat next to me open tomorrow too.

night_msg_yuna_3.name: {name}
night_msg_yuna_3.text: *While I reread the short, plain line “I'll keep the seat next to me open” over and over, the phone screen slowly dims.*

night_msg_dain_1.name: Dain
night_msg_dain_1.text: Hey, I never dreamed I'd lose a one-shot rock-paper-scissors.

night_msg_dain_2.name: Dain
night_msg_dain_2.text: Lunch tomorrow is a rematch, no matter what. Be ready haha

night_msg_dain_3.name: Dain
night_msg_dain_3.text: Ugh, the more I think about the soboro bread I got stuck paying for today, the more it stings. Seriously!

night_msg_dain_4.name: {name}
night_msg_dain_4.text: *Three lines fly in one after another, no time to breathe. A laugh bursts out of me, and before I know it I've typed “haha” into the reply box first.*

night_hidden_check.name: {name}
night_hidden_check.text: *As I go to close the messenger, another school app alert sits in the notification bar at the top.*

night_hidden_homeroom_1.name: {name}
night_hidden_homeroom_1.text: *A post the homeroom teacher just put up is on the class notice app. “Class 3-2 notice: Don't forget to bring your math textbook for period 1 tomorrow. — And the transfer student who arrived today only needs to settle in all right. That's enough.”*

night_hidden_homeroom_2.name: {name}
night_hidden_homeroom_2.text: *Only after I read the kind sentence added at the end of the notice once more do I lay the phone face down on my chest.*

night_hidden_nurse_1.name: {name}
night_hidden_nurse_1.text: *A new alert is up on the school health app. “Nurse's office record: Transfer student — mild, temporary dizziness. Drink plenty of lukewarm water tonight, and do not skip breakfast tomorrow. If the symptoms return, come to the nurse's office immediately.”*

night_hidden_nurse_2.name: {name}
night_hidden_nurse_2.text: *The school nurse's soft voice seems to linger by my ear, so I get up and fill the water bottle by my pillow.*

night_late_transition.name: {name}
night_late_transition.text: *I turn the light off and am just about to close my eyes when the phone vibrates softly again, breaking the quiet. The clock says 11 at night. Who is it at this hour?*

night_late_branch.name: {name}
night_late_branch.text: *In the dark room, the screen in my hand glows white.*

night_seo_late_1.name: Seoyeon
night_seo_late_1.text: Don't be late tomorrow morning either. See you at school.

night_seo_late_2.name: Seoyeon
night_seo_late_2.text: If you're not there on time, I'll come find you myself.

night_seo_late_3.name: {name}
night_seo_late_3.text: *I leave the short goodbye and set the phone by my pillow. On the fading lock screen, tomorrow morning's school alarm time shows clear.*

night_yuna_late_1.name: Yuna
night_yuna_late_1.text: *I open the chat, and only a gray notice sits there alone: “This message was deleted.”*

night_yuna_late_2.name: {name}
night_yuna_late_2.text: *The typing indicator blinks a few times, as if the other person is writing something, then quietly disappears.*

night_yuna_late_3.name: {name}
night_yuna_late_3.text: *I don't know how to speak first either, and while I only open and close the reply box, the screen light fades out.*

night_yuna_late_4.name: {name}
night_yuna_late_4.text: *On the glass screen, locked and black, only the faint mark of my hesitating thumb remains.*

night_dain_late_1.name: Dain
night_dain_late_1.text: Hey, don't tell me you're already asleep.

night_dain_late_2.name: Dain
night_dain_late_2.text: Looking for one person, first come first served, to come out to the field early tomorrow morning and warm up.

night_dain_late_3.name: Dain
night_dain_late_3.text: For the record, refusals are absolutely not accepted haha

night_dain_late_4.name: {name}
night_dain_late_4.text: *It's so absurd a laugh slips out, but my finger has already typed “I'm in” into the reply box.*

night_dain_late_4_b.name: {name}
night_dain_late_4_b.text: *Under Dain's message, excited-puppy emoticons pile on one after another.*

night_end_1.name: {name}
night_end_1.text: *I put the phone down and look up at the dark ceiling. From the new uniform on the hanger, the spring breeze and cherry-blossom scent that passed through today drift out, faint.*

night_end_3.name: {name}
night_end_3.text: *I take in the new names saved side by side in my contacts once more, then quietly turn the screen off.*

forced_violation_day1_after_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day1_after_seoyeon.text: *After a long silence, Seoyeon speaks in a voice hard as ice.* Don't think you can let what you just did pass like nothing happened. For a while, don't show up in front of me, and don't contact me.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day1_seoyeon_apologize.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day1_seoyeon_apologize.text: *Seoyeon's cold expression doesn't ease at all.* I heard the apology. But apologizing doesn't make what just happened disappear. Like I said, don't contact me for a while.

forced_violation_day1_seoyeon_excuse.name: Seoyeon
forced_violation_day1_seoyeon_excuse.text: *Seoyeon cuts me off in one stroke.* A misunderstanding? From the moment I clearly said no and drew the line, it couldn't be a misunderstanding. No more excuses.

forced_violation_day1_after_yuna.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day1_after_yuna.text: *Yuna steps back, her eyes gleaming cold.* I made it obvious I didn't want it, and you ignored me to the end. Right now I don't even want to see your face. Don't contact me again.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day1_yuna_apologize.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day1_yuna_apologize.text: *After a long silence, Yuna answers low.* One apology doesn't make it like nothing happened. Just go now.

forced_violation_day1_yuna_excuse.name: Yuna
forced_violation_day1_yuna_excuse.text: *Yuna turns her head without even hearing my explanation through.* I clearly said no. I'm not here to hear excuses.

forced_violation_day1_after_dain.name: Dain
forced_violation_day1_after_dain.text: *The usual smile is completely gone from Dain's face. After a long pause, a stiff, locked voice comes out.* This isn't a joke. You forced it even though I said no. I'm not letting that go.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day1_dain_apologize.name: Dain
forced_violation_day1_dain_apologize.text: *Dain bites her lip, and only after a long while does she spit out a short reply.* Fine. Let's stop here for today. Whether we talk again is up to me.

forced_violation_day1_dain_excuse.name: Dain
forced_violation_day1_dain_excuse.text: *Dain's voice turns rough and sharp.* No. Don't make some ridiculous excuse. You're the one who didn't stop even after I said no.

forced_violation_day1_after_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day1_after_teacher.text: *The homeroom teacher drops any trace of a smile and draws a firm line.* What you just did clearly crossed a line as a student. Don't come any closer. I'll handle this by the school rules and procedures.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day1_teacher_apologize.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day1_teacher_apologize.text: *The homeroom teacher takes a short breath and speaks calmly.* I received your apology. Even so, the necessary procedures will go forward by the rules. Go back for today.

forced_violation_day1_teacher_excuse.name: Homeroom Teacher
forced_violation_day1_teacher_excuse.text: *The homeroom teacher raises a hand and cuts off the explanation.* This isn't the time to start laying out excuses. Don't say any more. Keep your distance right now.

forced_violation_day1_after_nurse.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day1_after_nurse.text: *The easy smile vanishes from the school nurse's face in an instant.* Don't come even one step closer from now on. What you just did goes on the chart as it happened, and I'll tell the homeroom teacher too.
choices: Apologize without making excuses, then end the conversation.
Try to explain that it was a misunderstanding.

forced_violation_day1_nurse_apologize.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day1_nurse_apologize.text: *The school nurse closes the chart and answers firmly.* I'll hear the apology. But the official record and the report will go through the proper procedures. Let's end this conversation here.

forced_violation_day1_nurse_excuse.name: School Nurse
forced_violation_day1_nurse_excuse.text: *The school nurse's voice drops, cold.* You think wrapping it up as a misunderstanding changes what just happened? You ignored me even after I clearly refused.
